name: app-hotel-booking-experience-photo-and-phone-quad-slide
title: Booking Experience Photo and Phone Quad
whatItIs: A lavender slide titled Booking Experience with a plane progress bar, a paragraph and a 2-by-2 grid of rounded tiles: a hotel lobby photo with the app icon tile, a phone with a Recommend card and Hotel tab, a phone with a hotel search form and a blue bedroom photo.
whatItMeans: Alternating real photography and product tiles link the hotel world to the app in a calm blue palette.
techniques: 2-by-2 grid alternating photo and phone tiles
App icon tile overlaid on a photo
Blue gradient search and torn discount sticker
Photography colour-matched to the UI blue
Progress bar with a plane marker

vocabulary.definition: An app icon placed on a photo as a brand stamp.
Photography chosen to share the UI's colour.
